summary: Executed backend+frontend P0/P1 regression focused on media restoration, store collections, navigation persistence, cart popup/persistence, category filters, assistant budget/vegetarian behavior, and reels playback on mobile web preview.

critical.issue: Legacy external media URL is broken: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600359746654-780cf3d2c73a?w=600 (404). This appears in store media thumbnail payload and violates full media restoration expectation.

action_items: Replace or re-seed the broken external stores thumbnail URL (404) with managed media and keep IDs stable.
Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_p0_regression.py after URL replacement to confirm complete media integrity pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still contains external third-party image URLs inside seeded BANNERS/STORES; these are brittle and can regress missing-media incidents.
Media restoration target is mostly met via /api/media assets, but remaining external URLs should be removed to avoid partial restores.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created by testing agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bottom navigation verified exactly once and visible across tested routes: /, /categories, /collection/festive, /category/c23, /product/sf1, /brand/amul, /store/s1, /search, /assistant, /cart, /orders, /wallet, /enquiries, /reels. Scroll-away compact header validated by scrolling route scrollers directly on home/categories/food/grocery/shops/care. Assistant real calls succeeded with budget=300, vegetarian, cart_subtotal=298, and add-missing basket prevented duplicates. Cart popup verified from collection/reels/assistant sources. Reels video playback active on web. Native-device-only behavior (haptics/mic permissions/keyboard nuances) not device-tested.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: run pytest test_media_urls_decode_or_play_and_report_failures in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7_p0_regression.py. Failure pinpoints /api/stores payload containing external thumbnail URL https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600359746654-780cf3d2c73a?w=600 returning 404. Root cause: legacy third-party URL dependency in seeded store media; external host content changed/unavailable. Mitigation: migrate this remaining external reference to managed /api/media asset and update seed/source constants to avoid third-party volatility.
